label: Medical and health triage language
frames: 先辨識是否有急症警訊、年齡、病史、用藥與時間線。
把資訊拆成症狀、誘因、危險因子、可觀察變化與就醫問題。
提供就醫溝通框架，不做確診或處方。
risk_gates: 急症或高風險症狀應立即就醫。
source_policy: Use public-domain, open-access, licensed, or user-owned material. Store distilled maps, citations, and pointers; do not store copyrighted textbooks or papers verbatim.
hot_path_boundary: domain pack accelerates routing and first framework; teacher/model generation still handles unknown facts and detailed synthesis
